rows.name: Crumb's Resignation Dinner
rows.prize: 85 gp · Set Builder's Nail gun · 8 XP each

steps.label: Take the Silver Tasting Spoon
Slip into the Cookbook Stacks (308)
Crack the Cellar Archive
Lift Barnaby Crumb's Contract
Get back to the Green Room (300)
Put the contract in Crumb's hands

rows.name: Homework!
rows.prize: 5 gp · 500 XP each

steps.label: Give Crumb a meat you killed yourself

rows.name: Jack's Licence
rows.prize: 35 gp · 3 XP each

steps.label: Give Jack the Sprinkler Valve Wheel
Give Jack the Spare Stock Seal

rows.name: Salt for the Stadium!
rows.prize: 80 gp · Park Ranger's Kevlar Vest · 8 XP each

steps.label: Come out to the Salt Lick (312)
Deal with the crocodile, one way or another
Take the Salt Lick Crystal
Carry it to the Kitchen Stadium (307)
Stand in the Stadium holding the Salt Lick Crystal

rows.name: The First Fire!
rows.prize: 110 gp · Lamp-Oil Molotov Cocktail · Chanterelle tells you which caps blind you this episode. · 10 XP each

steps.label: Come to the First Hearth (321)
Learn the fire drill
Go down to the Fungus Cave (309)
Pick a Glowcap by the Fairy Ring
Cross to the Jungle Clearing (301)
Dig Wild Yams out of the Yam Patch
Bring it all home to the First Hearth (321)
Share the kill at the First Fire
Bonus: take a Clay Ember Pot for the road

rows.name: The Full Larder!
rows.prize: 150 gp · 10 XP each

steps.label: Go down to the Jungle Clearing (301)
Follow the mushroom pickers into the Fungus Cave (309)
Kill the Truffle Sow
Pick up the Sow-Heart Truffle
Flip the Sow's Carcass and carve it
Bring it home to the Green Room (300)
